concerns.text: The plan logit‑transforms ARI and NMI scores (bounded 0–1) before fitting the mixed‑effects model, but does not specify how it will handle values exactly equal to 0 or 1 (logit undefined → ±∞). This can produce infinite or NaN outcomes, violating model assumptions and causing the regression to fail.

It is unclear whether the mixed‑effects model will be fit separately for ARI and NMI, or whether a single combined “logit_fidelity” variable will be created from both metrics. Ambiguity may lead to double‑counting or inappropriate model specification.
